name: systeml-benchmark
description: A dataset for evaluating system-level behaviour of language models (system prompts, instructions and expected responses). It assesses how well models follow system-level instructions and produce appropriate, policy-compliant outputs across a variety of scenarios. The benchmark is oriented toward measuring instruction-following fidelity and response correctness.
reputation: A small, niche benchmark with limited public adoption, mainly used by its creator and a few community members.
